values.meaning: Empowered attack window after breaking invisibility
values.quote: empowers his next basic attack within {{fd|0.25}} seconds
{{as|{{critical damage|160|60}}|critical damage}} damage, increased to {{as|{{critical damage|200|100}}|critical damage}} if a critical strike was {{tt|rolled|See notes}}
values.binNote: The bin's QCritDamageMod = 1 + NonCritBackstabMod(0.6)*(critDamage - 1); at base 100% critDamage (2.0x) this gives 1.6x, matching the wiki's 160% non-rolled value. The 200% (2.0x) value applies when a crit is separately rolled, using the default crit modifier instead of this formula.

values.quote: after a {{fd|0.125}}-second delay, he {{tip|blinks}} to the target location

mechanics.claim: Deceive's invisibility breaks when Shaco uses a basic attack or casts Two-Shiv Poison, but not from casting Jack in the Box or Hallucinate.
mechanics.quote: ''Deceive's'' {{tip|invisibility}} breaks when '''Shaco''' uses a basic attack or casts ''{{ai|Two-Shiv Poison|Shaco}}'', but not from casting ''{{ai|Jack in the Box|Shaco}}'' or ''{{ai|Hallucinate|Shaco}}''.

mechanics.claim: The bonus damage from breaking invisibility adds directly to the damage instance of the empowered basic attack, and is affected by critical strike modifiers.
mechanics.quote: ''Deceive's'' bonus damage adds directly to the damage instance of the basic attack.

mechanics.claim: Using a basic attack breaks the stealth at the end of the attack windup, not immediately on cast.
mechanics.quote: Using a basic attack breaks the stealth at the end of the attack windup.

mechanics.claim: Cooldown starts only after the invisibility/blink effect resolves, not on initial cast.
